taylor: Quick report: onboarding run for magnet-13b int4 shows token repetition after a KV refill when we stream-prefill and then insert a small metadata prefix. Repro attached.

mira: What exact steps?

taylor: run: `python experiments/prefill_repro.py --model magnet-13b --quant int4 --prompt data/long_prefill.txt --seed 7 --max-len 4096 --stream-prefill --insert meta.json`

devon: Logs show repeat at boundary: gen@2049 repeats gen@2048. KV checksum changed for the same logical positions across refill.

sam: I could not reproduce on fp16 or int8. Only int4 path. Suggests rounding/quant error in rotary multiply or key encoding.

mira: Also reproduces slightly earlier on sharded Dedicated runs, likely due to shard position offsets.
taylor: Temporary mitigation: disable int4 for >2k contexts in onboarding until we patch.

devon: Plan: add unit test that simulates prefill->insert->refill, bisect int4 kernel rounding, and add nightly kv-hash check for long contexts.

ci-bot: CI job queued for branch rope-kv-checks: https://ci.internal/rope/999

mira: Filing BUG-3580 and assigning to @devon for kernel bisect. Will follow up with telemetry to find customer exposures.
taylor: Thanks all, will update onboarding docs and attach failing sample. :thumbsup:
